Smart Image Crop (Still): Detects a mask, creates a model-friendly crop, and outputs stitch metadata.
Smart Image Stitcher (Still): Stitches a processed crop back into the original image with blend and color-match options.
Load Image (Mask Paint): Load Image with a mask painter built into the node: brush, erase, rect marquee and size stamps.
Send to Load Image: Saves like Save Image and loads the result back into a chosen Load Image node.
Image Comparer (Smart): Hover slider A/B comparison with Send and Save results buttons.
